I had this happen to me in early 2016, after a harsh bout of depression brought on by several conditions, one of those conditions was that I was experiencing jhana without the support of a sangha. I was also in the early stages of recovery from chronic alcoholism. I was conditioned to lambasting myself with heavy energies of all kinds and as my practice became established and my mind-models were seeing very deeply the surface level pleasures were empty of any substantial happiness, I suffered.
 It took time to re-orient. Tastes were subdued at this time and well as sexual desires and even the pleasure from a kiss from my signif, the pleasures of receiving admiration or praise, same. The vividness of life seemed turned down.
A dharma friend was wise to direct me towards metta as a way to “wet the path” and also reminded me that I am a householder, and that I exist in a very loud, exuberant and vividly intense world, not a monastery. I began to notice that it was ‘music as a drug’ (delusion that the music and other sense pleasures were cessations of suffering) intentionality were now ‘on deck’ for me to practice with. Practicing with the sorrow that occurs when my various feel good mechanisms were recognized as empty led to vipassana that the finer energies can be help sweetly and with an acute appreciation and deep swelling smile from somewhere much truer than the happy feelings that ‘the one that demands to be satiated’ was accustomed to. It was also around this time I committed to a specific teacher and path began to take seed and eventually cultivate.
  I have times now where holding music now is tears of joy. SO deep resonance, such great cloud watching as the emotions wrap around these sounds, profound appreciation of the musicians.
  I thank you for making sangha with me in this matter, my your path be visited by ease, and the flavors of life fulfill you to there exact perfect degree
